player_prompt.intro:
O ni play Blackjack kei dealer.
Nomu ni oqo o na goal ke get as close to 21 as possible without going over.
Ena nomu ni turn, choro '[Hit]' me rawa kina na kerekere na card or '[Stand]' me taura.
J/Q/K = 10 na point; A = 11 or 1, ia na better.
